description: This file defines the custom exception class `NumberIsTooSmallException`, which extends `MathIllegalNumberException` and is used within the Apache Commons Math library to signal when a number is below a specified minimum threshold. It includes constructors for creating instances with contextual details and methods to retrieve class-specific information.

classes.name: NumberIsTooSmallException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating a number is smaller than a defined minimum, used within the Apache Commons Math library for input validation.

methods.name: NumberIsTooSmallException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with context, the incorrect value, the minimum allowed value, and whether the minimum is inclusive.

methods.name: NumberIsTooSmallException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific localizable message pattern, the incorrect value, the minimum allowed value, and whether the minimum is inclusive.

methods.name: getBoundIsAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether the minimum bound is inclusive in the allowed range.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum value that was used as a threshold in this exception.
